brief: A side fall from the guard: drop low and roll back onto the right side, so the hip side and the back take the landing and the Breakfall check passes.
notes: The Breakfall check (scripts/breakfall.gd) judges the landing (HEURISTIC thresholds named there); its spread rule counts the hip side only when the body has rolled over (the thighs' axis over 30 deg from the floor). The pelvis 'side' angle is its roll; negative rolls the body to its right.

asserts.line: pelvis side below -20 deg at 1.5 s +-9 f
